items.title: 증안펀드 기대·외국인 매수에 코스닥 6%대 급등…코스피 4,800대

items.title: 李대통령 지지율 41%·1%p↑…국내주식 거래 69%는 손실권[갤럽]

items.title: 코스닥 매수 사이드카…장중 5% 넘게 급등
items.snippet: 27일 한국거래소는 오전 10시 22분 코스닥 시장에 매수 사이드카를 발동했다.사이드카는 코스닥150선물이 6% 넘게 상승하고, 코스닥150 지수가 전 거래일보다 3% 이상 상승한 상태가 1분 동안 이어지는 경우 변동성 완화를 위해 발동된다.사이드카가 발동되면 프로그램 매수 호가의 효력이 일시 정지된다.현재 시각 코스닥 시장은 전장보다 34.30포인트(5.23%) 상승한 690.01에 거래되고 있다. 수급상 기관과 외국인이 각각 1천526억 원, 1천122억 원 사들이면서 지수 상승세를 견인했다.ybnoh@yna.co.kr<저작권

items.title: KCGI운용, 亞금융사 대표 초청해 '한국 자본시장 세미나'

items.title: 검사·제재 쇄신안 내놓은 금융당국…정작 난제는 '후속 TF'로
items.snippet: 금융위원회와 금융감독원이 8개월여에 걸쳐 마련한 금융행정 쇄신안을 두고 업계 일각에서는 '용두사미'에 그칠 수 있다는 우려가 나온다. 두 기관의 이해관계가 첨예하게 맞물린 핵심 쟁점들이 대부분 구체적인 결론 없이 후속 논의로 넘어갔기 때문이다.금감원의 공공기관 지정 여부를 결정할 공공기관운영위원회(공운위) 심사를 앞두고 일단 큰 틀에서 합의를 이뤘지만, 후속 논의 과정에서 쇄신안 핵심 과제들이 흐지부지될 수 있다는 우려가 나온다.27일 금융당국에 따르면 금융위와 금감원은 지난 3월부터 총 9차례에 걸쳐 '금융행정 쇄신' 태스크포스

items.title: 외국인이 오프라인 받친 무신사, 3분기 매출 34% 늘어

items.title: 거버넌스포럼 "김용범 개혁위원장 내정 대환영…대통령 용단에 경의"
items.snippet: 한국기업거버넌스포럼이 김용범 메리츠금융지주 부회장의 자본시장 개혁 민간기구 위원장 내정을 환영하며 이재명 대통령의 전폭적인 지원을 당부했다.한국기업거버넌스포럼은 27일 논평을 내고 "대한민국 최고의 자본시장 전문가를 발탁한 이재명 대통령의 용단에 경의를 표한다"며 "국내외 투자자들도 김 부회장의 새로운 역할을 매우 긍정적으로 받아들일 것"이라고 밝혔다.특히 최근 외국인 투자자들 사이에서 정부의 자본시장 정책이 후퇴하는 것 아니냐는 우려가 커지고 있다는 점을 짚었다.포럼은 의무공개매수제도 도입 논란을 대표적인 사례로 꼽았다.아시아기

items.title: "K-뷰티 수요증가 대비하자"…코스맥스, 부자재 공급망 강화

items.title: 서학개미가 골라 담은 다섯 종목…공통점은 널뛰는 주가
items.snippet: 미국 기술주가 급락과 반등을 거듭했던 사이 서학개미의 장바구니는 유독 가격이 크게 움직이는 종목들로 채워졌다.하루 30% 넘게 뛴 엔비디아는 물론 상장 직후부터 주가가 출렁인 앤트로픽이 대표적이다. 반도체주와 나스닥100지수의 하루 등락률을 두세 배로 따라가는 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)에도 반등을 노린 자금이 대거 몰렸다.27일 한국예탁결제원에 따르면 최근 일주일(18~25일 결제 기준) 국내 투자자의 미국 주식 순매수액은 미국 반도체 3배 ETF인 '속슬(SOXL)'이 가장 많았다. 이어 엔비디아, 앤트로픽, 나스닥100 3

items.snippet: “다음에는 내 차례가 될 수 있다는 생각에 판사들이 위기의식을 느끼고 있다.” 서울의 한 부장판사는 최근 법관들이 더불어민주당의 조희대 대법원장 탄핵 추진에 공개적으로 우려를 밝히고 나선 배경을 이렇게 설명했다. 이재명 정부 출범 이후 이어져 온 사법개혁 국면에서 판사들은 집단 행동을 자제해 왔다. 대법관 증원과 재판소원제, 법왜곡죄 도입 등을 놓고 판사들은 지난해 12월 법관대표회의를 통해 유감을 표명하는 데 그쳤다. 하지만 조 대법원장 탄핵에 대해서는 25일 창원지법에서 전체판사회의가 열리는 등 반발 기류가 거세지고 있다. 그 배경에 대해 또 다른 부장판사는 26일 “전례가 생기면 그다음은 쉽다”며 “대법원장도 탄핵했는데 앞으로 일개 판사 정도야 쉽게 탄핵할 수 있다고 생각할 것”이라고 말했다. 수도권에서 근무하는 한 부장판사도 “하급심...

items.title: “당 꼬라지하곤”까지 나온 국힘, 최고위 ‘조작 징계’ 충돌 아수라장
items.snippet: 국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 무소속 한동훈 의원 등의 징계를 결정하는 과정에서 국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 개입했다는 의혹 제기가 이어지는 가운데, 26일 당 최고위원회의에서 장 대표 측 최고위원들과 친한(친한동훈)계 최고위원이 정면으로 충돌했다. 이 과정에서 설전이 계속되자 양측을 중재하던 정점식 원내대표는 “당 꼬라지하고는”이라며 회의장을 떠났다. 의혹을 둘러싼 내홍이 깊어지는 상황에서 계파 간 갈등까지 공개적으로 불거지며 난맥상이 그대로 표출된 것. 친한계를 중심으로 한 의원총회 소집 요구에 원내지도부가 응하면서 의총이 당내 갈등의 분수령이 될 것이라는 전망이 나온다.● 당권파 vs 친한계 공개 충돌 이날 오전 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 친한계를 향해 포문을 연 것은 원외 당권파인 김민수 최고위원이었다. 김 최고위원은 “일부 우리 당 의원들은...

items.title: 與, ‘정부 광고 중지’ 등 언론4법 소위 강행… 전문가 “정치적 악용 가능성”
items.snippet: 허위·조작정보 유통으로 배액배상이 확정되거나 허위사실 적시 명예훼손 혐의로 유죄가 확정된 언론사에 대해 정부광고를 최대 1년간 중지할 수 있도록 한 정부광고법 개정안 등 이른바 ‘언론 4법’이 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 문화체육관광위원회 법안소위를 통과했다. 언론단체들은 “사법적 책임이 완료된 사안에 행정적 불이익을 가하는 과잉 규제”라며 “비판 보도를 위축시키는 ‘전략적 봉쇄 소송’에 악용될 우려가 있다”고 반발했다. 민주당은 이날 문체위 소위에서 국민의힘이 불참한 가운데 ‘언론 4법’을 단독 처리했다. 국민의힘은 전날과 이날 소위에서 언론을 포함한 공청회 개최를 요구했지만 받아들여지지 않자 퇴장했다. 정부광고법 개정안은 지난해 민주당이 강행 처리해 올 7월부터 시행된 정보통신망법 개정안에 따른 허위·조작정보나 불법 정보의 배액배상이 확정된...

items.title: 최민희 징계 심의 하루 앞, 與 4선 이상 중진들 회동
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 최민희 최고위원에 대한 당 윤리심판원의 징계 심의를 하루 앞둔 26일 4선 이상 중진 의원들이 만찬 회동을 갖고 당 내홍 수습 방안을 논의했다. 4선 중진인 김민석 대표와 정청래 전 대표가 나란히 불참한 가운데 중진 의원들은 “당의 통합과 신뢰 회복이 중요하다”고 입을 모은 것으로 전해졌다. 이날 민주당 4선 이상 중진 의원 12명은 서울 여의도 모처에서 2시간가량 만찬 회동을 진행했다. 한 중진 의원은 통화에서 “당 화합과 단결과 민생을 위해서 우리 중진들이 할 역할을 좀 다하자고 이야기 나눴다”고 전했다. 정성호 의원은 이날 “당이 굉장히 지금 난망한 상황인데 수습이 돼야 하지 않겠냐”며 “발언 수위에 맞게 적정한 정도의 처분을 내려야 될 것으로 본다”고 말했다. 27일 최 최고위원에 대한 윤리심판원의 징계 수위에 따라 계파...

items.title: ‘비거주 1주택’ 국세청장 후보 “국민 눈높이에 미흡”
items.snippet: 안덕수 국세청장 후보자(사진)는 배우자 소유의 서울 아파트에 실거주하지 않은 데 대해 “국민 눈높이에 미흡했다”며 사과했다. 안 후보자는 26일 국회 재정경제기획위원회 인사청문회에서 배우자 명의로 보유한 서울 동대문구 이문동 아파트에 실거주한 사실이 없다는 지적을 받고 “국민 눈높이에 좀 미흡한 것 같고 이유 여하를 불문하고 죄송스럽다”고 말했다. 이어 “지난해 1월 아파트가 준공됐을 당시에는 아이들이 대학 진학을 앞둔 상황이라 해당 주택에 입주하기 곤란했다”며 “자녀의 학업이 정리되는 대로 조속히 입주하도록 하겠다”고 해명했다. 안 후보자 배우자는 2010년 이 아파트를 3억3500만 원에 취득했다. 이후 해당 주택이 재개발에 들어갔고 지난해 1월 새 아파트로 준공됐다. 하지만 안 후보자 가족은 이 아파트를 세주고, 서울 강남구 역삼동 아파...

items.title: 한자리 모인 37개국 무관들 “K방산 기업에서 신뢰관계 느껴”
items.snippet: “한국 방산기업이 단순히 무기를 만들고 수출하는 것이 아니라 다른 국가와 신뢰 관계를 맺는 차원에서 사업을 대하는 것이 느껴졌습니다.” 26일 서울 중구 더그랜드롯데 서울에서 동아일보·채널A 주최로 열린 ‘동아 K-방산포럼 2026’에 참석한 주한 일본대사관의 한 주재 무관이 한 말이다. 그는 “동아시아에 엄중한 안보 환경이 계속되는 만큼, 한일 간에도 방산 협력이 필요하지 않을까 싶다”고도 했다. ‘K-방산, 세계를 넘어 미래로’를 주제로 진행된 이날 포럼에선 글로벌 방산시장의 변화 속 K방산의 지속가능한 성장 방안이 논의됐다. 이날 행사에서는 정부와 정치권, 국내외 방산기업 관계자 등 100여 명의 방위산업 리더들이 모였다. 특히 올해는 37개국, 50여 명의 한국 주재 외국 대사관 무관들이 참석해 국내외 방산 기업들과 네트워크를 다지는...

items.title: 방산 기업들 “국가차원 로드맵 제시를”… 與野의원들 “입법 적극 지원”
items.snippet: ‘동아 K-방산포럼 2026’에 참석한 정부와 정치권 관계자들은 국가 안보를 넘어 경제 성장과 국제 협력에 기여하고 있는 방위산업에 대한 적극적인 지원을 약속했다. 기업들은 K방산의 도약을 위한 정부의 체계적인 지원을 주문했고, 지방자치단체들도 방산 생태계 구축에 적극 나서겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 26일 국회 국방위원회 소속 김성회 더불어민주당 의원은 축사에서 “국방 인공지능(AI)의 기반을 세우고 첨단 무기를 더 빨리 전력화하기 위한 법안을 심사하고 있다”며 “대기업과 중소·중견기업이 함께 성장하는 방산 생태계가 자리 잡도록 힘쓰겠다”고 말했다. 국방위 야당 간사인 임종득 국민의힘 의원은 “첨단기술에 대한 과감한 투자와 전문인력 양성, 국제 공동개발 및 수출 지원체계 강화 등 미래 경쟁력을 선제적으로 확보해야 한다”며 “현장의 목소리를 입법과...

items.title: 中대사 “韓에 난민 신청한 중국인 송환을” 이례적 요청
items.snippet: 다이빙(戴兵) 주한 중국대사가 이달 초 김병찬 제주경찰청장을 만나 제주에 체류 중인 것으로 알려진 중국인 왕하이 씨의 신병 확보에 협조해 달라고 요청한 것으로 확인됐다. 중국 당국은 왕 씨가 수백억 원대 사기를 친 후 제주도로 도피했다고 보고 신병을 확보해야 한다는 입장이다. 반면 왕 씨는 자신이 30년간 ‘짝퉁’ 상품을 고발해 온 소비자 운동가로, 중국 당국의 탄압을 피해 한국에 들어와 망명을 신청했지만 거부된 상태라는 입장이다. 26일 국회 외교통일위원회 소속 국민의힘 안철수 의원실이 제주경찰청에서 제출받은 자료에 따르면 다이 대사는 ‘2026 한중 미래발전 제주·중국 교류주간’ 참석차 제주를 방문한 5일 김 청장과 면담했다. 당시 제주경찰청이 작성한 접견 보고서에 따르면, 다이 대사는 이 자리에서 “중국에서 수백억 원대 사기를 치고 제주...

items.title: ‘한덕수 내란재판 위증 혐의’ 尹 무죄 확정
items.snippet: 대법원이 한덕수 전 국무총리의 내란 혐의 재판에서 위증한 혐의로 기소된 윤석열 전 대통령에 대해 무죄를 확정했다. 대법원 1부(주심 마용주 대법관)는 26일 내란 특검(특별검사 조은석)의 상고를 기각하고 윤 전 대통령에게 무죄를 선고한 원심을 확정했다. 윤 전 대통령은 지난해 11월 한 전 총리의 내란 우두머리 방조 등 혐의 재판에 증인으로 나와 위증한 혐의로 기소됐다. 특검은 윤 전 대통령이 당초 국무회의를 열 생각이 없었다고 보고 기소했다. 하지만 1심과 항소심은 이를 인정할 증거가 부족하다고 판단했고, 대법원도 원심 판단에 잘못이 없다고 봤다. 대법원은 “형사재판에서 유죄의 인정은 합리적 의심의 여지가 없을 정도로 공소사실이 진실한 것이라는 확신을 갖게 하는 증명력을 가진 증거에 의해야 한다”며 “그와 같은 증거가 없다면 설령 피고인에게...

items.title: “재외동포청 세종행, 인천시 항의도 못해”
items.snippet: 인천 지역사회에서 논란이 컸던 외교부 산하 재외동포청의 세종 이전이 결국 확정됐다. 인천에 터를 잡고 출범한 재외동포청이 3년 만에 인천을 떠나게 되면서 인천시의 책임과 대응을 둘러싼 비판이 거세질 전망이다. 26일 인천시에 따르면 행정안전부는 24일 ‘중앙행정기관 등의 이전계획 변경’을 고시했다. 내년부터 2031년까지 수도권 31개 기관을 세종으로 옮기는 내용을 담은 이번 고시에는 인천에 있는 재외동포청의 이전 계획도 포함됐다. 재외동포청은 내년 우선 이전 대상 22개 기관에 이름을 올리면서 출범 3년 만에 인천을 떠나는 계획이 확정됐다. 이들 기관은 내년 세종의 민간 건물 등을 임차해 쓰는 방식으로 이전할 예정이다. 재외동포청 이전을 둘러싼 논란은 올해 초부터 끊이지 않았다. 올해 초 재외동포청이 비싼 청사 임차료 등을 이유로 서울 이전...

items.snippet: Spanish monetary economist Pablo Hernandez de Cos on Thursday was set to replace France's Christine Lagarde as the new head of the European Central Bank (ECB). His nomination comes as the Europe's most powerful financial institution grapples with an Iran war-driven resurgence in inflation and a cost of living crisis.

items.title: [오늘의 날씨] 2026년 11월 27일
검찰총장 후보 전례없는 ‘추가 추천’ 받는다
items.snippet: 법무부가 공소청 출범 후 첫 검찰총장 후보를 국민에게 추가로 천거받는다고 26일 밝혔다. 법무부는 지난달 한 차례 국민 천거를 받았는데, 추가로 후보를 물색해보겠다는 것이다. 검찰총장 국민 천거를 두 차례 받는 것은 전례 없는 일이다. 법무부는 추가 천거를 받는 이유와 관련해 “지난 천거 절차 종료 후 천거 결과를 포함한 제반 사정 등을 종합해 검토한 결과, 추천위의 실질적 추천 기능을 보장할 필요성이 있어 추가 천거 절차를 시행하게 됐다”고 했다. 추가 천거 기간은 오는 30일부터 다음 달 9일까지다. 지난달 1차 천거 때 접수된 사람들도 후보로 포함한다.

items.title: “수능으론 잠재력 평가 못해… 대학이 돈·시간 들여 시스템 만들어야”
items.snippet: “​수능은 학생 인생을 좌우할 정도로 막강한 힘을 갖고 있지만, 학생의 잠재력을 평가하는 데 적합한 시험이 아닙니다. 이제 대학들이 학생 선발에 더 많은 자원을 투입해 한 명 한 명 공들여 뽑아야 합니다."

items.title: 꼭꼭 숨은 수능 가채점 만점자들
items.snippet: 지난 19일 치러진 2027학년도 대학수학능력시험에서 가채점 만점자가 최소 4명인 것으로 파악됐다. 예년에는 시험 직후 학교나 학원을 통해 가채점 만점 소식이 잇따라 전해졌지만, 올해는 ‘인공지능(AI) 커닝’을 의심받을 수 있다는 우려에 수험생들이 성적 공개를 꺼린다고 입시 업계는 전했다.

items.snippet: "Reddit typically gets you as a young adult, and then you season over time in this incredible way," Jen Wong tells Fortune.

items.title: 건물 한 층에 3700명분… 서울 한복판 친구집은 ‘대마 공장’이었다
items.snippet: 친구 사이인 A(29)씨와 B(29)씨는 지난해 1월부터 서울 성북구 주택가 건물 4층을 통째로 빌려 대마를 재배해 오다 적발돼 최근 중대범죄수사청에 구속됐다. 중수청은 현장에서 건조 대마 1.1㎏과 재배 중인 대마 33주를 압수했다. 3700명이 동시에 투약할 수 있는 분량이었다. C(33)씨는 지난해 3월부터 올 5월까지 서울 중랑구 자택에서 대마를 재배하다가 적발돼 징역 1년에 집행유예 2년을 선고받았다. 적발 당시 C씨가 보유한 대마는 587g으로, 1200명이 투약할 수 있는 분량이었다. C씨는 자기 집 1층 세탁실 뒤편과 2층 다락방에서 대마를 재배했다.

items.title: 해외 명품가구가 반값? 600명이 물건 못 받아
items.snippet: 유명 온라인 가구 판매 쇼핑몰 ‘바우트’는 해외 명품 가구를 정가보다 50~60% 저렴하게 판매하면서 소비자 사이에서 입소문을 탔다. 그러나 1년여 전부터 소비자가 결제한 가구 배송을 미루기 시작하더니 최근에는 사무실을 폐쇄하고 연락이 두절됐다. 결국 피해자들이 바우트 대표 박모(46)씨를 사기 혐의로 경찰에 고소했다. 바우트에 가구를 주문하고 결제까지 했다가 물건을 받지 못한 피해자는 600명이 넘는 것으로 알려졌다.

items.title: 인천 남동산업단지 공장서 화재… 직원 1명 숨져
items.snippet: 26일 오후 12시 15분쯤 인천 남동구 고잔동 남동국가산업단지 내 자동차 부품 공장에서 불이 나 검은 연기가 치솟고 있다. 이날 화재로 직원 1명이 숨지고, 3층 규모 공장 건물이 다 탔다. 소방당국은 화재 발생 3시간 49분 만에 불을 완전히 껐다.

items.title: 尹 ‘한덕수 재판 위증’, 대법서 무죄 확정
items.snippet: 대법원 1부(주심 마용주 대법관)는 26일 한덕수 전 국무총리 내란 사건 재판에서 위증한 혐의로 기소된 윤석열 전 대통령에게 무죄를 선고했다. 윤 전 대통령이 지난 7월 ‘고위공직자범죄수사처 체포 방해’ 사건으로 징역 7년을 확정받은 뒤 나온 두 번째 대법원 판결이다.

items.title: “나눔 함께해요” 자선냄비 전달식
items.snippet: 한국구세군과 휘슬러코리아가 26일 오전 서울 중구 서울광장에서 ‘2026 사랑ON 자선냄비 전달식’을 열었다. 아이들이 자선냄비 앞에서 구세군 종을 울리고 있다.

items.title: 여학생 절반 “스트레스” 남학생의 1.5배 달해
items.snippet: 술을 마시는 중·고교 여학생의 절반 이상은 한 번에 평균 소주 3잔 이상을 마시는 ‘위험 음주’를 하는 것으로 나타났다. 전체 청소년의 음주율은 낮아졌지만, 술을 마시는 여학생의 위험 음주율은 2023년부터 4년 연속 증가했다.

items.title: 악성 민원 ‘진상 학부모’ 학교에 발 못 붙이게 한다
items.snippet: 정부가 교권을 보호하고 무고성 아동 학대 신고를 줄이기 위해 관련 법 개정에 나선다. 교권을 침해한 학부모는 상당 기간 학교 출입을 못 하게 하는 제도도 도입한다.

items.title: ‘서울 최대 재개발’ 한남3구역 23년 만에 첫삽
items.snippet: 서울 최대 재개발 사업지인 용산구 한남3구역이 26일 공사를 시작했다. 2003년 뉴타운으로 지정된 지 23년 만이다. 한남뉴타운 5개 구역 중 첫 착공이다. 2030년 한강변 낡은 주택가가 5970가구 아파트 단지로 바뀔 전망이다.

items.title: “현대차 시설 4년내 가동… 군산을 제2 울산으로”
items.snippet: 김재준(55) 전북 군산시장은 26일 본지 인터뷰에서 “임기 내 현대차그룹 공장이 실제로 가동되도록 하는 게 목표”라며 “군산을 제2의 울산으로 만들겠다”고 했다.

items.title: “루돌프야, 너랑 함께 달까지 달리고 싶어”
items.snippet: “산타 할아버지, 저는 하늘을 날고 싶어요. 하늘을 나는 날개를 주세요.”

items.title: 철도망 구축하려 ‘원팀’ 된 충청… KTX 세종역 신설엔 딴 목소리
items.snippet: 중앙 행정기관 추가 이전과 대통령 세종집무실, 국회 세종의사당 건립을 앞두고 충청권이 철도망 확충에 나섰다. 세종시는 도심에 KTX역을 신설해 전국 주요 도시와 직접 연결한다는 구상이다. 충북은 청주국제공항과 오송역을 중심으로 철도망을 확충해 행정수도의 관문 역할을 강화한다는 전략이다. 대전은 정부세종청사와 정부대전청사를 잇는 광역급행철도를 서대전역까지 연장할 계획이다. 충남은 충남도청이 있는 내포신도시와 세종 등을 연결하는 철도 건설을 추진하고 있다. 국토교통부는 다음 달 제5차 국가철도망 구축계획(2026~2035년)을 확정·발표할 예정이다.

items.title: Lost homes, stolen freedom: National Book Award winners on exile and imprisonment
items.snippet: Two books about losing everything have just won America's most prestigious literary honours. Hannah Lillith Assadi took the National Book Award for fiction for "Paradiso 17", a novel inspired by her late father, who was driven from Palestine in 1948 during the Nakba. Abdelrahman ElGendy won the non-fiction prize for "Huna", his memoir of six years as a political prisoner in Egypt, arrested at 17 alongside his father....

items.title: “네 개의 심장 소리 듣고 하나도 포기 할 수 없었죠”
items.snippet: 지난 18일 오전 11시 경기도 안양의 한 주거용 오피스텔 거실에 생후 15개월 된 네 쌍둥이 태이·채이·래이·재이가 함께 놀고 있었다. ‘태채래재 네 쌍둥이’로 불리는 이들 중 둘째 채이가 딸, 나머지 셋은 아들이다. 아이들은 거실을 기어다니다 서로 다리를 잡아보기도 하고, 한참 눈을 맞추기도 했다. 한 아이가 웃으면 다 같이 “까르르” 웃고, 한 아이가 손뼉 치면 다른 아이들도 따라 쳤다. 엄마 조세린(35)씨가 “이제 낮잠 잘 시간이야” 하자, 아빠 국은혁(36)씨가 아이들을 차례로 침대로 옮겼다. 처음엔 떼쓰던 아이들이 5분쯤 지나니 다 같이 잠이 들었다. 조씨는 “아이가 넷이라 자기들끼리 놀고, 잠도 침대에서 다 함께 잔다”고 했다.

items.title: [우리 아기가 태어났어요] 장하영·박종혁 아들 수호 외
items.snippet: 온 가족에게 기쁨을 안겨 준 아기의 탄생을 알려주세요. 홈페이지 주소 입력창에 아가야안녕.com이라고 입력하면 됩니다. 매일유업 육아 정보 사이트 매일아이(maeili.com)를 통해서도 접속할 수 있습니다. 추첨을 통해 출산 소식과 사진이 지면에 실린 가족에게는 ①케이크 구매권 ②엄마와 아이를 위한 매일두 포인트 3만원 ③출산 소식을 생일 날짜 본지 1면에 담은 PDF 파일 ④조선일보 1개월 무료 구독권을 드립니다. 당첨자 중 한 가족을 선정하여 해당 지면을 고급 프레임에 담아 제공하는 조선일보 리프린트도 제작해 드립니다. 홈페이지에서는 균형 영양식 메디웰 2만원 할인 혜택도 드리고 있습니다.

items.title: [알립니다] 우리 아이 출생 소식 액자에 담아 간직하세요
items.snippet: 조선일보에 실린 아기 출생 소식, 본인이나 지인의 인터뷰·사진 기사를 영원히 추억으로 간직하세요. 조선일보는 독자가 원하는 신문 지면을 그대로 고급 액자에 담아 드리는 ‘조선일보 리프린트’ 서비스를 합니다. 매주 ‘아이가 행복입니다’ 지면에 소개된 한 가족을 추첨해 리프린트를 선물로 드립니다. 지난 20일 ‘우리 아기가 태어났어요’ 코너에 실린 김연서 양이 이번 주 주인공입니다. 자세한 내용은 홈페이지(reprint.chosun.com)에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

items.title: 김용준·권남근 등 ‘성균언론인상’
items.snippet: 성균관대 출신 언론인 모임 성균언론인회(회장 이종환)는 26일 ‘2026 자랑스러운 성균언론인상’ 언론 부문에 김용준 한국경제 편집국장과 권남근 헤럴드경제 편집국장을 선정했다. 대외 부문에는 오광수 법무법인 대륙아주 대표변호사와 윤영선 전 관세청장이 선정됐다. 시상식은 30일 오후 7시 성균관대 600주년 기념관 조병두홀에서 열릴 예정이다.

items.title: 홍진욱·김건일 아시아기자協 이사
items.snippet: 아시아기자협회(AJA·이사장 이기우)는 25일 서울 한국프레스센터 20층 무궁화실에서 창립 22주년 정기 이사회를 열고 홍진욱 전 주싱가포르 대한민국 대사와 김건일 전 한라일보 대표이사를 신임 이사로 선임했다.

items.title: 李 “불법어업 담보금 대폭 상향 효과 확실하지요?”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 26일 “불법어업 담보금 대폭 상향 효과가 확실하지요?”라며 “국민주권정부는 대한민국 어업주권도 확실히 지킨다”고 말했다.이 대통령은 이날 오후 자신의 X(엑스)에 글을 올려 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령은 해당 글에 불법 중국어선에 부과하는 (불법어업) 담보금을 최대 3억 원에서 15억 원으로 상향 조정한 이후, 담보금 납부 부담 때문에 어선 소유권을 포기하고 조업을 중단하는 사례가 잇따르고 있다는 내용의 기사를 첨부했다. 앞서 해양경찰청은 불법 중국어선 담보금을 상향 조정한 ‘경제수역어업주권법’이 5월 시행된 이후 총 13척에 127억3000만 원의 담보금이 부과됐다고 밝혔다. 그러면서 개정법 시행 전에는 중국어선 대부분이 담보금을 납부하고 풀려났지만, 올해는 고액의 담보금을 내지 못해 배를 포기하는 사례가 늘고 있다고 전했다...

items.title: Brightening spin- and parity-forbidden interlayer excitons through rhombohedral stacking
items.abstract: Brightened symmetry-forbidden excitons can provide critical information about the electronic structure and many-body interactions in semiconductors. Recently, interlayer atomic registry has emerged as a new way to control atomically thin layered materials in both ground and excited states. Here we show that the rhombohedral stacking in a 3R-MoS_2 homobilayer can brighten two symmetry-forbidden interlayer excitons: one is a spin-unlike 1s exciton and the other is a parity-odd 2p exciton. The nature of these interlayer excitons is revealed by their gfactors as well as the hybridization patterns observed when they are tuned to resonate with intralayer excitons. Surprisingly, the hybridized 2p exciton exhibits a constructive quantum interference between the acquired transition dipoles, revealing a hidden gauge-invariant phase contrast between the constituent electronic states. items.title: Localization of an Individual Charge Fluctuator in a Si/SiGe Spin Qubit Device
items.abstract: Charge noise from two-level fluctuators (TLFs) limits gate fidelities in semiconductor spin qubits, yet locating individual fluctuators within a device remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate a spatial triangulation method that combines the gate dependence of a TLF's detuning with the chemical potential shifts it induces in a sensing dot. Applying this method to previously reported measurements from a gated Si/SiGe quantum dot device, we use electrostatic simulations to jointly constrain the fluctuator's three-dimensional position and the magnitude of its electric dipole moment. We localize the fluctuator to a region spanning 31 nm by 1 nm laterally and 4 nm vertically within the bulk of the atomic layer deposited aluminum oxide, identifying the material hosting this individual charge-noise source. items.title: Direct generation of N00N states with layered semiconductors
items.abstract: Photonic N00N states enable phase sensing beyond the classical limit, but their generation conventionally relies on interferometric manipulation of photons using bulk optical components. Here we demonstrate the direct generation of a family of tunable two-photon polarization N00N states from a subwavelength-thick 3R-MoS2 flake. For propagation along the optic axis, the in-plane crystal symmetry allows all symmetry permitted spontaneous parametric down-conversion pathway to interfere coherently, while the large second-order nonlinearity provides sufficient brightness at submicrometer thickness without phase matching. The pump polarization sets the basis of the N00N state or equivalently a two-photon Holland-Burnett state without altering its structure or the generation efficiency. items.snippet: 경기도에 사는 김모(64)씨는 최근 피부 문제로 상담을 받기 위해 동네 의원을 찾았다. 의원 간판엔 분명 ‘진료 과목 피부과’라고 돼 있었다. 그런데 진료를 받고 돌아온 뒤, 자신을 진료한 의사가 피부과 전문의 자격이 없는 일반의라는 사실을 알게 됐다. 김씨는 “당연히 피부과 전문의인 줄 알았는데, 뭔가 속은 기분이었다”고 했다. 현행법상 피부과 전문의가 아니면 ‘○○피부과의원’이란 명칭은 쓸 수 없다. 하지만 ‘○○의원, 진료 과목 피부과’라고 표시할 순 있다. 의사 면허만 있으면 전문의 자격이 없어도 피부과 진료를 할 수 있기 때문이다. 이는 다른 진료과도 마찬가지지만, 특히 최근 젊은 의사들이 많이 진출하는 피부·미용 분야에서 전문의 자격을 둘러싼 혼란이 크다는 지적이 나온다.

items.title: AFM metrology for 3D high aspect ratio semiconductor structures
items.abstract: Transistors have long been the foundation of the semiconductor industry, with continuous architectural innovations enabling the scaling of integrated circuits while maintaining high performance. Advancements in deposition and lithographic techniques have further expanded design possibilities, while increasing structural complexity demands stricter process control. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) offers a rapid and reliable metrology solution, providing high-resolution measurements and robust statistical analysis of critical parameters. In this work, we present clearly resolved individual profiles of lines and spaces in high aspect ratio (HAR) gate all around FET (GAAFET)-type structures on both the nanosheet (NS) region and in the isolation region between the nanosheets and we present a comprehensive statistical evaluation of their critical dimensions.

items.title: High-Precision Photometry with a scientific CMOS Camera: III Lab and on-Sky testing of Andor Toran-26B
items.abstract: Scientific CMOS cameras are increasingly used in modern astronomy, offering CCD-like performance with lower power use, faster readout, and reduced cost. We evaluate the photometric precision of the Toran-26B camera, featuring the IMX571 sensor from Sony, a new CMOS camera from Andor Technology, through laboratory and on-sky tests in its two modes: high well capacity (HWC) and low noise (LN). Key metrics include read noise, dark current, photo and dark signal non-uniformity, quantum efficiency, and window transmittance. The median read noise is 1.07\,e$^-$ (LN) and 2.79\,e$^-$ (HWC). Bias shows minor dark signal non-uniformity: 0.076\,e$^-$ (LN), 0.173\,e$^-$ (HWC). Pixel well depth reaches 15700\,e$^-$ (LN) and 50000\,e$^-$ (HWC), with dynamic ranges of 83.39\,dB and 85.05\,dB, respectively. items.title: Real-Time Cryo-CMOS Photon-Number Readout from a Single SNSPD
items.abstract: Measurements leveraging the intrinsic photon-number resolution of Superconducting Nanostrip Single-Photon Detectors (SNSPDs) have recently gained traction due to the simplicity of the detector design. Intrinsic photon-number measurement schemes using SNSPDs encode the photon-number information in picosecond signal timing; these systems thus require high bandwidth readout and sensitive electrical measurement equipment. We show a cryogenic electronic circuit operating close to the SNSPD in the cryostat, which can isolate single-photon detection events directly from the SNSPD signal. This reduces the latency of the photon-number readout to (13.9 $\pm$ 0.3) ns, which enables feedforward operations based on intrinsic photon-number measurements with low latency.

items.title: Bayesian Calibration of Effective Material Parameters in Electric Machine Stators
items.abstract: Efficiency-driven faster switching by wide-bandgap semiconductor devices increases electromagnetic interference (EMI) in electric vehicles (EVs). Mitigating this EMI becomes more complex as system components grow. Therefore, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) is assessed early via system-level simulation of the EV powertrain. A key EMC-critical quantity is the impedance of the electric drive machine, forming a major part of the EMI propagation path. Finite element (FE) simulations are typically used but are computationally expensive and limited by insufficient material property knowledge. We present a surrogate model based Bayesian calibration framework for 3D full-wave FE simulation of an externally excited synchronous motor (EESM) stator. items.title: Revisiting the Schottky-Mott Relation for Metal/ Transition Metal Dichalcogenide Interfaces: The Role of Interface Dipoles
items.abstract: High contact resistance, predominantly stemming from Fermi-level pinning (FLP), becomes a critical bottleneck in the contact engineering of transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) based two-dimensional field-effect transistors (2DFETs). Our study re-examines the inherent nature of FLP in 2D semiconductors, particularly focusing on regimes where the material thickness is commensurate with the interface thickness. Through the synergistic application of first-principles calculations and experimental validation via ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (UPS) and scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS), we rigorously establish the metal effective work function (eWF) as the definitive figure of merit for substantiating the Schottky-Mott relation. items.title: Carrier relaxation confines the Bogdanov--Takens degeneracy of an optically injected semiconductor laser
items.abstract: Optically injected semiconductor lasers are forced nonlinear oscillators whose locking boundaries are organized by codimension-two points. We ask which property of the carrier balance permits or forbids a Bogdanov--Takens (BT) point in the standard three-dimensional rate equations. Taking the carrier inversion $n$ as distinguished observable, the rate that enters the spectral conditions is the slope of the gain--loss balance, $ξ=\partial\dot n/\partial n=-2Γ/κ$, where $Γ$ is the damping of the relaxation oscillation and $κ=1+2Bn$ the normalized stimulated-emission factor. The two BT conditions become affine in $ξ$ and imply the exact sum rule $K^{2}=I[1-(1+κ)I]$ between injection amplitude $K$ and intracavity intensity $I$. items.title: From Entropy Source to Stochastic Bit-Stream: Low-Cost Converters for True-Random Stochastic Computing
items.abstract: Stochastic computing (SC) encodes values as the probability of ones in random bit-streams, which allows arithmetic circuits with very low area and power and a natural tolerance to faults. The accuracy and security of an SC system depend on the quality of those bit-streams. Conventional generators build them from pseudo-random or quasi-random sequences, which are predictable, periodic, and correlated across streams drawn from the same generator. This work proposes three methods for converting the unbiased outputs of a true random number generator (TRNG) into stochastic bit-streams (SBS) with arbitrary target probabilities: a block extraction and comparison circuit, a counter-logic circuit, and a cascaded majority-logic pipeline. items.title: A scalable dense silicon qubit architecture with logical operations
items.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) requires a large number of physical qubits to encode logical qubits with sufficiently low error rates. Silicon spin qubits are a promising platform because of their small footprint, compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing technologies, and demonstrated high-fidelity operations. However, realizing a scalable architecture that supports quantum error correction, qubit transport, wiring, and logical gate operations remains a major challenge. Here, we propose a scalable dense silicon spin qubit architecture designed to support large-scale FTQC. The architecture consists of qubit memories, data qubit lanes, and cross junctions. Qubit memories store logical qubits encoded using the rotated surface code and support logical single-qubit operations. items.title: Low-barrier-height Hf$_\text{1-x}$Zr$_\text{x}$O$_2$ ferroelectric tunnel junctions with large ON-state currents
items.abstract: Ferroelectric tunnel junctions (FTJs) hold great promise for nonvolatile memory, neuromorphic computing, and other applications. Hf$_\text{1-x}$Zr$_\text{x}$O$_2$ (HZO) has become a leading candidate for the tunnel barrier due primarily to its compatibility with CMOS technology. Recent advances on HZO based FTJs have highlighted the importance of understanding the electrical transport through a ferroelectric tunnel barrier for fulfilling the technological promises of FTJs. In this paper we report investigation of HZO FTJs featuring a barrier of ultrathin HZO ($\leq$5nm) measured down to a temperature of 2 K. Direct quantum tunneling was found to dominate at low temperatures, along with contributions from trap-assisted tunneling. As the temperature increases, conduction by thermal activation takes over. items.title: Physics-Based TCAD Modeling of Nanowire Cryotrons with Coupled Superconducting and Thermal Dynamics
items.abstract: Nanowire cryotrons (nTrons) provide gate-controlled superconducting switching, current gain, and high-impedance outputs for cryogenic computing, detector readout, and superconductor-semiconductor interfaces. We develop a physics-based Sentaurus TCAD framework that couples time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau dynamics, separate electron and phonon energy equations, and mixed-mode circuit simulation. Superconducting terminal-current corrections connect the custom solver to the native electrical solution, linking local suppression of superconductivity, heating and cooling, and current redistribution in the external circuit. To our knowledge, this is the first Sentaurus-based mixed-mode TCAD implementation for nTrons. items.title: Unveiling ferroelectricity in wafer-scale beta-phase In$_2$Se$_3$
items.abstract: Pushing ferroelectricity to the ultimate thickness limit is a central challenge for memory hardware, because conventional three-dimensional ferroelectrics degrade through depolarization and interfacial effects when thinned. Here we identify $β$-In$_2$Se$_3$, a van der Waals semiconductor regarded as centrosymmetric, as a host of bistable polar order arising from a picometre-scale distortion within each quintuple layer. The polar state has out-of-plane and in-plane components, is switched by a vertical electric field, and persists to the bilayer limit (~1.9 nm) with an estimated coercive field of 0.9 MV/cm and an apparent remanent polarization of 11.0 $μ$C/cm$^2$. Films grown by metal-organic chemical vapor deposition on 2-inch wafers yield capacitor arrays with a switching-voltage spread below 5% across 100 devices, an endurance of $10^7$ cycles and a projected ten-year retention. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. items.title: A library-based approach for inverse reconstruction of cavity depth using angle-resolved cathodoluminescence
items.abstract: In nanofabrication processes, accurate metrology is a crucial step for obtaining control over the required critical dimensions in a device. Traditionally, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) is used to obtain high resolution measurements of the lateral dimension, but obtaining depth information on a thick sample is more complex. In this work, we use angle-resolved cathodoluminescence (AR-CL) spectroscopy to resolve this third dimension. Using 30 keV electrons in the SEM, CL is created at the bottom of a micrometer scale cavity milled in a gold surface. We show that reflections of the CL off the cavity sidewalls produce an interferogram which is a sensitive probe for the cavity geometry. Here we investigated the electron spin properties of silicon vacancy centers (V1 and V2) both electron spin $S = 3/2$ in 4H-SiC in the temperature range $T=80-300$~K using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR). items.abstract: The General Antiparticle Spectrometer (GAPS) is a balloon-borne experiment designed to perform three long-duration flights from Antarctica to search for low-energy cosmic antinuclei, in particular antideuterons, as an indirect signature of dark matter. Its detection method relies on the formation and decay of exotic atoms, identified through the emission of characteristic x-rays and the subsequent annihilation into secondary particles. At the core of the instrument is the silicon tracker, composed of lithium-drifted silicon detectors operated at -40°C and read out by a custom application-specific integrated circuit, SLIDER32, implemented in 180 nm CMOS technology. This thesis reports on the integration, calibration, and validation of the SLIDER32-based tracker readout electronics. items.title: Certified minimax normal-scale mixtures for the logistic-normal integral
items.abstract: The logistic distribution function is a scale mixture of normal distribution functions, and Monahan and Stefanski approximate it by the $K$-term mixture $Λ(x) \approx \sum_{i} w_i Φ(s_i x)$ chosen to minimise the uniform error on the real line. Each such mixture reduces the logistic-normal integral to a sum of $K$ normal distribution functions with the mixture's uniform error bound. This integral is the expectation of a logistic sigmoid over a normal distribution in statistics and the Gauss-Fermi integral in semiconductor physics. Monahan and Stefanski tabulate constants for $K \le 8$ and conjecture that the optimal error equioscillates at $2K$ points, while above $K = 8$ the Remez exchange and local solvers stall at nonequioscillating stationary points. We prove that the tangent space of the mixture family is a Chebyshev system, which forces $2K$-point equioscillation at every interior...

items.title: First-principles phase diagram of monolayer CrS$_2$ polymorphs under biaxial strain and its sensitivity to the Hubbard U parameter
items.abstract: In correlated two-dimensional magnets the balance between competing electronic and magnetic phases is often set by the strength of the on-site Coulomb interaction, so that the predicted ground state can hinge on a parameter that is not uniquely defined. Monolayer CrS$_2$ lies squarely in this regime, hosting several energetically close polymorphs whose character ranges from non-magnetic semiconducting to magnetically ordered metallic. We therefore investigate, using DFT$+U$ within the generalized gradient approximation, the structural, magnetic, and electronic properties of the 1H, 1T, 1T$'$, and 1T$''$ polymorphs of monolayer CrS$_2$ under varying Hubbard interactions ($U=0$--$8$~eV) and biaxial strain ($-10\%$ to $+10\%$). items.title: N-Polar AlGaN/GaN Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor
items.abstract: Heterojunction bipolar transistors based on the III-Nitride systems have significantly lower performance than field effect transistors due to challenges associated with p-type doping of the base. N-polar AlGaN/GaN HBTs can overcome these challenges by polarization-induced holes in the base and base-emitter interface. We experimentally demonstrate the first N-polar AlGaN/GaN heterojunction bipolar transistors (HBTs) grown by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy on GaN substrate without emitter regrowth. The HBTs exhibit a peak current gain of approximately 15, peak differential current gain of approximately 18, and emitter-area-normalized peak current densities exceeding 20 kA/cm^2 and 66 kA/cm^2 for emitter areas of 10 x 10 um^2 and 3 x 10 um^2, respectively. The specific contact resistance for base is estimated 1.32 x 10^{-2} Ohm.cm^2. The open-base breakdown voltage is characterized...

items.title: Real-Time AI Acceleration on a 2D Spatial Dataflow Architecture
items.abstract: Machine Learning (ML) is increasingly being integrated into real-time systems, which makes the timing analysis of ML accelerators necessary. However, the most popular commercial accelerator, the Graphics Processing Unit (GPU), remains difficult to analyze as several aspects of its behavior, including scheduling of threads involved in single-instruction multiple-thread computations and memory access latency, are not fully documented. Spatial dataflow accelerators present an interesting alternative to GPUs, as they inherently support compute and memory partitioning. Data movement and computation locality are explicitly controlled by the programmer. In this work, we consider the Tenstorrent Blackhole, which is based on a commodity RISC-V architecture. It consists of a 2D grid of cores connected by Networks-on-Chip (NoCs), supporting a fully open software runtime. We profile the Blackhole pl...

items.title: Neural-operator acceleration of bidirectional phonon Boltzmann-Fourier coupling for multiscale heat transport in silicon fin arrays
items.abstract: Localized heating in semiconductor devices can produce non-diffusive phonon transport near heat-generating regions, while heat spreading through the surrounding substrate remains well described by Fourier conduction. We present a hybrid framework that couples a pretrained neural operator for the phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) within individual fins to a Fourier model of a shared substrate. To reduce the cost of repeated BTE solves across fin positions and coupling iterations, a DeepONet maps each fin's substrate-interface temperature and heating state to its temperature and heat-flux fields. The operator is trained on interface temperatures generated by a linearized proxy of the coupled problem, which avoids explicit training data collection from full coupled runs. items.title: Resilience of Entangling Gates to Spatiotemporally Correlated Noise
items.abstract: As quantum processors scale, spatially and temporally correlated noise is emerging as a limiting factor in the fidelity of multiqubit gates. Here we show that this makes the choice of entangling operation a first-order design decision: for two-qubit gates in semiconductor spin qubits, the CZ and $\sqrt{\mathrm{iSWAP}}$ gates exhibit a pronounced resilience to correlated noise relative to the SWAP gate, even though correlated fluctuations of the entangling interaction can degrade gate performance to a level comparable to that of local noise. We trace this hierarchy to the redistribution of noise-sensitive channels away from zero frequency and show it to hold for noise spectra dominated by low-frequency weight, including $1/f$ and Lorentzian. items.title: Generalized dielectric-dependent hybrid functional combining Gaussian and Yukawa screening
items.abstract: We develop a generalized Coulomb-attenuated method (GCAM) for dielectric-dependent hybrid functionals that combines Gaussian and Yukawa-type screening functions to provide an accurate representation of the random-phase approximation (RPA) dielectric function. Through systematic fitting to RPA dielectric functions of semiconductors and insulators, and to the Lindhard dielectric function of the homogeneous electron gas, we demonstrate that GCAM significantly reduces errors in the model dielectric function across the full momentum range. However, despite this improved physical description of screening, band gap calculations reveal that GCAM yields larger errors compared to experiment than previous CAM approaches for wide-gap materials, but smaller errors for most narrow-gap materials. items.title: Two-dimensional Thyristor
items.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors offer a viable platform for next-generation electronics beyond sub-3 nm nodes, yet essential nonlinear circuit elements, such as thyristors, remain unexplored on atomically thin platforms. Here, we report an atomically thin reconfigurable electro-optical thyristor based on a lateral WSe2-MoSe2-WSe2-MoSe2 PNPN heterostructure, directly grown via sequential edge epitaxy. Unlike single-junction 2D diodes, this multijunction architecture exhibits thyristor-like nonlinear switching, including forward blocking, abrupt snapback, bistability, and electrical latching. The device exhibits a forward-blocking voltage of 183 V, corresponding to a critical electric field of 1 MV/cm. items.title: Scanning nanowire quantum dot with radio-frequency read-out
items.abstract: Scanning single-electron transistors (SETs) are highly sensitive local probes of charge and electric potential, but their integration with robust height control for scanning probe microscopy remains challenging. Furthermore, readout bandwidths are limited to tens of kHz, while characterizing faster charge dynamics is often of interest. Here, we present a scanning SET in the form of a nanowire (NW) quantum dot (QD) integrated at the apex of a non-contact atomic force microscopy (NC-AFM) cantilever. We demonstrate NC-AFM topographic imaging and local electrometry capability by mapping the electrostatic potential generated by a set of nanoscale voltage-biased gate electrodes. Comparison with electrostatic simulations shows agreement with the measured potential profiles. items.title: Centimetre-sized meteoroids from the active asteroid (3200) Phaethon: lunar impact flashes during the 2018 and 2025 Geminids
items.abstract: Centimetre-sized meteoroids released by the active asteroid (3200) Phaethon, parent of the Geminid meteor shower, probe the ejection of refractory material from a comet-asteroid transition object and the age of the stream; lunar impact flashes (LIFs) are the only ground-based technique that samples this size range. We determine the impact flux, mass and size distributions, and expected crater sizes of Geminid meteoroids on the Moon from campaigns at the 2018 and 2025 maxima, and test the stability of the centimetre-sized population over seven years. Both campaigns used the Nihon University 0.40 m "GUNDAM" telescope with CMOS video cameras at 60 fps, with candidates validated at independent stations; a common aperture-photometry pipeline calibrated in the Cousins R band gave peak magnitudes to 0.1-0.25 mag. items.title: Anatomy of orbital and spin responses in GaAs and Si: Hall, inverse Faraday, and magneto-optical Kerr effects
items.abstract: Magneto-optical signals in nonmagnetic semiconductors entangle spin and orbital contributions, both in angular-momentum generation and magneto-optical detection. We calculate these contributions for electron-doped GaAs and Si using density-functional theory, linear-response theory, and a second-order density-matrix treatment of the inverse Faraday effect. We show that orbital- and spin-resolved optical Hall and polar Kerr coefficients exhibit stronger sensitivity to orbital moments than to equal spin moments. items.title: Numerical simulations of CCP-2D GEC with sGMRES
items.abstract: Fluid models provide an efficient means of simulating the low-temperature gas discharges, which are important in semiconductor manufacturing. This work presents, to the best of our knowledge, the first systematic numerical framework for the Gaseous Electronics Conference (GEC) reference cell of the 2D capacitively coupled plasma (CCP). The framework employs a structured, nonuniform cylindrical mesh to resolve the spatial gradients. A semi-implicit Scharfetter-Gummel (SG) scheme is used for the Poisson's equation, while the implicit SG schemes are applied to the continuity equations and the electron energy equation. Both the explicit and and the implicit formulations based on the conventional drift-diffusion terms are also investigated. items.abstract: Controlling polar domains in conducting materials by external fields could unlock polarization-based electronic functionalities, yet remains experimentally challenging. While mechanical actuation driven by local strain, stress, or strain gradients has been proposed as an external-voltage-free route, its experimental demonstration in relatively conducting polar materials remains limited. Here we demonstrate mechanically induced polar-domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave (CDW) semiconductor EuTe4 at room temperature, whose resistivity is on the order of 10 m$Ω$cm. Polarized-light microscopy and second-harmonic-generation measurements reveal CDW-induced in-plane polarization domains with an approximately 90 $^\circ$ domain configuration. items.abstract: Non-Gaussian bosonic states such as the Schrödinger cat states are essential for continuous-variable quantum-information processing. A convenient and deterministic process for generating cat states is through the use of a Rabi interaction between a single bosonic mode and a spin which facilitates a state-dependent displacement. items.title: Population of spin orbit-split-electron branches in semimetallic HgTe quantum wells
items.abstract: We present the results of experimental studies on magnetoresistance, the Hall effect, and Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations performed in gated heterostructures with HgTe-based gapless semiconductor quantum wells. We show that in quantum wells with widths corresponding to a semimetallic charge carrier spectrum, electrons, in contrast to the idealized model, populate both spin-orbit-split branches of the spectrum. This occurs regardless of whether the Fermi level lies exclusively in the conduction band or within the conduction-valence band overlap region.

items.title: JAX-Nano: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver for Nanoscale Heat Transfer
items.abstract: As semiconductor device dimensions approach phonon mean free paths, heat transport enters ballistic and quasi-ballistic regimes where Fourier's law becomes inadequate. The phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) describes these nonequilibrium effects but presents significant computational challenges. This work introduces JAX-Nano, a GPU-accelerated, end-to-end differentiable phonon BTE solver for nanoscale heat transport. The solver integrates steady-state and transient BTE formulations within a unified finite-volume framework, supporting structured and unstructured meshes, mode-resolved transport, phonon scattering, volumetric heat generation, and multiple boundary conditions. Automatic differentiation enables gradient computation with respect to transport properties, boundary conditions, heat-generation rates, and geometric parameters without separately derived adjoint equations. items.title: First-Principles Investigation of the {ScSe2} TMDs Monolayer: Structural Stability, Electronic and Optical Properties
items.abstract: We present an ab initio investigation of the {ScSe2} monolayer using density functional theory (DFT), as employed in the CP2K code, to assess its structural stability and electronic properties. The electronic behavior of both phases is governed by the local coordination environment of scandium and the associated lifting of degeneracy of its $3d$ orbitals. The valence bands (VBs) are dominated by {Se}$-4p$ states in both phases, while the states near the Fermi level distinguish the metallic 1T phase from the semiconducting 2H phase. Optical response calculations reveal markedly different spectral signatures for the two polymorphs. Two findings emerge from this study: a polymorphism-driven metal-to-semiconductor transition without any change in chemical composition and distinct optical responses relevant to phase-selective optoelectronic devices.

items.title: CHARMS250V1: A Cryogenic Front-End ASIC for Low-Noise Readout of Charge or Light Signals in Noble Liquid Detectors
items.abstract: This work presents the design and measurement results of CHARMS250V1, a next-generation cryogenic front-end application specific integrated circuit (ASIC) developed using a 65 nm CMOS process. It is designed for low-noise readout of charge or light signals generated in noble liquid detectors. CHARMS250V1 is a single channel prototype whose design in the future will be integrated within a 16-channel ASIC. It comprises pre-amplification and pulse shaping stages that provide programmable charge gain between 4.3 mV/fC and 25 mV/fC, peaking time programmable between 250 ns and 2 us, and programmable baseline of either 200 mV or 900 mV for processing of unipolar and bipolar signals, respectively.

items.title: Optical Scintillation Imaging for Dynamic Source Tracking Dosimetry During Prostate HDR Brachytherapy
items.abstract: High-dose-rate (HDR) brachytherapy is highly conformal, but its accuracy depends on catheter and source placement, and clinical workflows lack real-time in vivo dosimetry (IVD) that verifies delivery without disrupting the procedure. We characterize a scintillator-based optical dosimeter integrated into a transrectal probe that tracks source position, speed, dose rate, and time-resolved cumulative dose. A 67 mm x 5 mm line scintillator is imaged by a CMOS camera through a 30-degree endoscopic lens; geometric and flat-field corrections remove barrel distortion and vignetting. Absolute dose was calibrated with a TOPAS Monte Carlo model of the probe's air-cavity geometry. The system was validated in a water phantom with an Ir-192 source and needles at radial offsets of 7, 10, and 15 mm. Response varied by $\pm$2\% along the 67 mm scintillator and was linear over 5-21 cGy/s ($R^2 \geq 0.995$...

items.title: Physical Learning for Autonomous Tuning of Spin Qubits in Electrostatically Defined Quantum Dots
items.abstract: Tuning electrostatically defined quantum dots remains a primary bottleneck in the scalability of semiconductor spin qubits. While existing solutions rely on machine learning algorithms, these approaches require global information, introduce latency bottlenecks, and tax the limited cooling power available at cryogenic stages. Here, we demonstrate an FPGA-in-the-loop learning paradigm that bypasses digital computing overhead by utilizing multiplexed gradient descent (MGD) for tuning. Implemented on an FPGA and an emulated quantum dot device, our system autonomously tracks environmental drift, dynamically recovers from discrete charge jumps, and maintains steady-state stabilization in low signal-to-noise ratio regimes, without prior knowledge of the device's cross-capacitance matrix. The system also navigates the charge-stability landscape to stabilize the quantum dot around optimal operati...

items.title: Coherence Lengths of Laser Pointers
items.abstract: We report on the coherence lengths of low-cost green laser pointers in the midst of multimodal behavior using an optical interferometer based on noncollinear beam geometries and a CMOS detector array. Examined devices include three diode lasers and a frequency-doubled neodymium-emission diode-pumped solid state (DPSS) laser. Coherence length measurements are variable among devices, but values can nevertheless regularly exceed 10 cm. The work serves as a template for an advanced undergraduate physics laboratory experiment and may inspire new kinds of laser pointer devices utilizing interference effects as operative principles.

items.title: Specification-Grounded Adaptive Triage and Formal Invariant Exclusion Synthesis for Autonomous Silicon Coverage Closure
items.abstract: Closing the final 5%-15% of code and functional coverage remains a major schedule bottleneck in silicon tapeouts. Existing LLM-based coverage closure loops feed raw uncovered RTL lines or branches directly into iterative prompts, failing on industrial subsystems due to: (1) token and context explosion from querying thousands of correlated holes independently; (2) illegal stimulus that violates cross-signal invariants and yields dirty coverage; and (3) unsafe exclusion hallucination on structurally unreachable dead code. We present ARGUS (Autonomous Reachability & Guided Unified Stimulus), a specification-grounded, dual-regime coverage closure and formal exclusion synthesis engine. items.title: Magnon high-harmonic generation by nonlinearities of spin torque driven by phonon-mediated crossing of many-body energy levels of bright and dark excitons
items.abstract: Recent intense experimental focus on CrSBr, a two-dimensional (2D) antiferromagnetic semiconductor, has revealed numerous surprises in its response to ultrafast optical drive. We demonstrate that a single microscopic mechanism accounts for two of them---high-harmonic generation of magnons and persistence of magnon oscillations over \mbox{$\sim 1$ ns} time scale that is much longer than the femtosecond laser pulse (fsLP) pump duration. This mechanism arises from an unusually complex interplay of four different fundamental quasiparticles of condensed matter physics: magnons, optically bright and dark excitons, and phonons. By viewing magnons as the system and the other three quasiparticles as a quantum many-body bath, we derive an extended Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (eLLG) equation. items.title: From power to spectrum: an off-the-shelf photodiode turned into a spectrometer by its bias alone
items.abstract: Computational spectrometers replace dispersive optics with detectors whose spectral response can be varied, but every reported single-detector device obtains this response through dedicated fabrication: two-dimensional heterostructures, graded epitaxial junctions, organic stacks, filters or photonic circuits. We demonstrate a generic, fabrication-free alternative in which a standard commercial photodiode becomes a spectrometer through its electrical drive alone, requiring no modification of the device, no optical filter and no modulation of the light. The mechanism is bias-modulated optoelectronic chromatic dispersion (OED): light of different wavelengths is absorbed at different depths, and a sinusoidal bias changes how carriers generated at each depth are collected, so that every spectrum is encoded in the shape of the photocurrent waveform over one bias period. items.abstract: A fundamental property of interlayer excitons is their dipolar character, enabling electrical tunability, enhanced exciton-exciton interactions and extended lifetime. It is important for studying collective phenomena and realizing novel optoelectronic devices. However, in homo- or heterostructures based on two-dimensional semiconductors, the magnitude and orientation of the dipole moment are commonly locked due to spatially confined charges and nature of the band transition. Here, we use gate-dependent photoluminescence of few-layer R-WSe2 to harness sliding ferroelectricity for controlling the exciton dipole configuration of emerging layer-hybridised excitons. items.title: Topology-Enabled Self-Verification of Quantum Hall Resistance Standards
items.abstract: The scaling of multi-element quantized Hall array resistance standards necessitates rigorous validation that internal quantization has not broken down without relying on the verification of dissipationless edge state transport. One proposed solution is to use a Symmetric Precision Quantization Reliability criterion, a mathematical framework that statistically assures such validation strictly through outer terminal measurements of Cn-symmetric designs. This criterion essentially bounds the likelihood of hidden localized defects arising from quantum Hall breakdown and has potential uses in quantum computing and semiconductor testing but is presented in the context of its application toward quantum electrical standards.

items.title: Thermal investigation of buffer and transition layers in AlGaN HEMT stacks
items.abstract: In this work, we investigate thermal transport in a set of thin-film layers used in modern HEMT designs. Our theoretical analysis employs three phonon-transport models of increasing sophistication, ranging from a relatively simple Debye-approximation model to a first-principles framework that incorporates Density Functional Theory (DFT)-derived harmonic and anharmonic phonon properties. To describe ternary semiconductors, alloy scattering is also considered, and to account for the properties of non-ideal, polycrystalline thin films, scattering at grain and film boundaries is taken into account. For modeling the specific samples at hand, the latter are fitted to thermal conductivity data measured with Time-Domain Thermoreflectance (TDTR). Overall, we find that the first-principles model performs best and produces the most physically consistent results. Special emphasis is placed on establ...

items.title: CRAFT: Analog Circuit Design by Reasoning LLM Agents from Pre-Computed Lookup Tables
items.abstract: Automated analog circuit sizing methods, from black-box optimizers to recent large language model (LLM) agents, typically search the design space with a SPICE simulator in the loop, whereas an experienced designer works out a design by hand analysis. This paper presents CRAFT, a flow in which an LLM agent designs a given topology by calculation, as a designer does, and without an initial sizing. The agent works only through DeX, a service that uses pre-computed lookup tables to provide device characteristics and to solve the whole netlist for its operating point and small-signal response. It thus designs without SPICE, and every final design is verified independently in HSPICE. We test CRAFT on four circuits in a commercial 28 nm process; the largest is a 37-transistor three-stage amplifier with 53 design variables, 20 specifications and 74 saturation constraints. items.title: Origin and hole-density dependence of the intrinsic spin Hall conductivity in inorganic halide perovskites
items.abstract: Metal halide perovskites have spin-orbit coupling among the strongest in semiconductors, yet whether their centrosymmetric bulk phases can convert charge current into spin current, and what controls the response, is unknown. Here we identify, from first-principles calculations on the four all-inorganic compounds CsBX3 (B = Pb, Sn; X = Br, I), the factors that govern their intrinsic spin Hall conductivity. The conductivity arises from the spin Berry curvature of the spin-orbit-split halide-p bands, 1.1-2.6 eV below the valence band maximum, and exceeds that of III-V and group-IV semiconductors when the Fermi level lies inside them. Because the valence band maximum is an s-p singlet, shifted only in second order, these contributions cancel in the undoped compounds, which respond like conventional semiconductors. items.title: Interfacing Silicon Nitride Nanophotonics with Cuprous Oxide Rydberg Excitons
items.abstract: Rydberg excitons in cuprous oxide (Cu$_2$O), the solid-state counterpart of Rydberg atoms, are hydrogen-like electron--hole quasi-particles with micron-sized wavefunctions and strong long-range interactions that promise optical nonlinearities at the few-photon level. Exploiting them in a waveguide quantum electrodynamics (WQED) setting can enable what atomic Rydberg platforms achieve only with ultrahigh vacuum and laser cooling/trapping---a guided optical mode interfaced with the Rydberg medium---while adding the scalability and advanced fabrication of integrated photonics. Here we demonstrate a monolithic, CMOS-compatible interface of Cu$_2$O Rydberg excitons with a SiN$_x$ nanophotonic waveguide. items.title: Asymmetric Transistor Aging Under Thermal Gradients
items.abstract: Advanced technology nodes improve performance but increase susceptibility to BTI-induced aging. Using aging- aware circuit simulations, we show that realistic on-chip thermal gradients can cause significant asymmetric transistor degradation in 16 nm FinFET circuits, leading to setup and hold time violations. These results highlight the necessity of incorporating thermal-gradient-aware aging analysis into timing signoff to ensure chip reliability.

items.title: Design and Modeling of Graded Base III-Nitride HBTs for High-Frequency Applications
items.abstract: This work analyzes the high-frequency performance constraints of AlGaN/GaN heterojunction bipolar transistors (HBTs) and proposes a novel band-engineered graded base N-polar AlGaN/GaN HBT and evaluates the RF performances. Unlike conventional p-GaN base designs, we propose a graded base in the N-polar orientation which offers polarization-induced hole accumulation with quasi-electric field-assisted minority carrier transport. The proposed design simultaneously mitigates the longstanding current crowding, Webster effect, and conventional base resistance limitations. Using well-calibrated two-dimensional TCAD simulations, the proposed compositionally graded base HBT projects peak f_T/f_{MAX} of 190/200 GHz with a power density (V_{BR}I_{MAX}/8 > 20 W/mm), offering a promising pathway toward simultaneous high-frequency and high-power GaN millimeter-wave electronics.

items.title: Optical readout of MicroPattern Gaseous Detectors with SiPMs
items.abstract: Scintillation light readout of MicroPattern Gaseous Detectors (MPGDs) is used for imaging and track reconstruction applications including in optical Time Projection Chambers (TPC). Typically, high resolution CCD or CMOS imaging sensors are used and PMTs can be employed to obtain auxiliary timing information. We report on the optical readout of MPGDs with Silicon Photomultipliers (SiPMs) which enables limited spatial resolution. Arrays of SiPMs were used to read out Gaseous Electron Multipliers (GEMs) and Glass Micromegas amplification stages. Center of gravity reconstruction of hit positions yields a spatial resolution of approximately 1.35 mm for signals shared across multiple SiPMs. High gain of the amplification stage as well as the SiPMs enables good signal sharing and is advantageous for position reconstruction.

items.title: Reliable arithmetic circuits using less reliable (sub-digital) logic
items.abstract: The frequent static failure of CMOS logic gates at ultra-low voltages has historically been perceived as a strict barrier to extreme voltage scaling: this paper introduces a statistical circuit law proving this intuition wrong. We discovered a universal power law connecting gate and circuit static failure probabilities, revealing that circuit failure requires the simultaneous breakdown of an entire gate cluster rather than a single component. Because the required cluster size increases rapidly as voltage drops, low-voltage \textit{sub-digital} logic exhibits surprising inherent resilience to static failure. This insight stems from new theoretical tools we developed to quantify static failure, extending well beyond conventional voltage-margin analysis. Consequently, sub-digital processors could potentially offer a viable, near-term solution to drastically reduce the energy demands of AI.

items.title: Delay Mismatches Shape the Spectra of Three Synchronized Semiconductor Lasers
items.abstract: We study a network of three synchronized chaotic lasers and the radio frequency spectra of the intensity fluctuations. The position and morphology of the peaks are significantly different depending on the set of lasers being synchronized. The lasers and coupling paths are similar but not identical in all parameters, including their feedback and coupling delay times. The inverse of the delay mismatch between each pair of lasers introduces characteristic frequencies that shape the spectral response of the synchronized system. By studying two different three-laser configurations, we find that peaks appear whenever multiple harmonic contributions overlap in frequency, resulting in constructive enhancement of the spectral power. items.title: Ultrafast Successive Control and Electrical Detection of Long-Lived Valley Polarization in Room-Temperature Germanium
items.abstract: Germanium (Ge) hosts four degenerate valleys in the conduction band minima, and their highly anisotropic effective masses offer a valley degree of freedom in transport phenomena via anisotropic conductivity. Using time- and polarization-resolved terahertz spectroscopy combined with deformation potential theory, we reveal a valley relaxation time reaching 10 ps near the band edge of Ge(001) at room temperature, long enough to detect the valley polarization in electrical transport measurements. We also demonstrate sub-picosecond complete reversal of valley polarization by off-resonant light pulses at extremely low energy consumption. These results pave the way for room-temperature valleytronics based on bulk indirect-gap semiconductors compatible with existing electronics.

items.title: Fault-tolerant quantum processor with minimal external control
items.abstract: Contemporary classical information processors integrate tens of billions of transistors printed on a chip, yet are fully controlled through comparatively few external wires. This is possible because data flows through hard-coded operations in step with a global clock and is steered by external instructions. Today's solid-state quantum processors are different -- every qubit receives instructions from outside the chip via its own dedicated control line, and error correction adds a further torrent of syndrome data that is transported off-chip. Here we show that the external control of a quantum chip can be greatly simplified. We propose a fault-tolerant architecture for universal quantum computation, inspired by modern classical processors, in which quantum information flows through a fixed, clocked device, propelled by local gates in a planar array. Tuning spreading transport in GaN HEMTs with an AlN space layer under non-equilibrium heating
items.abstract: Lateral spreading transport dominates near-junction heat dissipation in GaN high-electron-mobility transistors, yet thermal control has largely overlooked this geometry. It neither reaches the core AlGaN/GaN region nor, beyond the spatial spreading itself, accounts for the spectral non-equilibrium of the heat source. Here we tune the spreading resistance directly by inserting a thin, highly conducting AlN space layer above the source to intercept heat and divert it laterally. We test this approach across GaN, AlGaN/GaN, and AlGaN/AlN/GaN structures under both equilibrium and longitudinal-optical (LO)-pumped non-equilibrium heating, pairing non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) with full-band phonon Monte Carlo (MC). items.abstract: For the first time, this work evaluated whether 4-tier stacked transistors can translate the straightforward density gains into realistic chip-level scaling benefits. A practical dual-sided 4-tier transistor-stacking CFFET (Flipped CFET-to-CFET) process was proposed, on which a DTCO framework spanning standard-cell design, local interconnects, RO analysis, and physical implementation was built under 2A node design rules. items.title: A Probabilistic Behavioral RTL Simulation Framework for Probabilistic Compute Fabrics
items.abstract: Coupled oscillator Ising hardware can produce different solution qualities across repeated runs of the same problem, while a deterministic behavioral model used for the design yields a single outcome under fixed conditions. Capturing this stochastic variability during design time is essential for evaluating how closely simulation reflects silicon behavior. This work presents a probabilistic behavioral RTL simulation framework that introduces Gaussian timing variation into coupling delays. This variation changes oscillator timing during evolution, producing different outcomes across runs while retaining the existing chip control and readout blocks. The framework is evaluated against measurements from two chips: a 28-nm CMOS chip with 66 spins and a 16-nm FinFET chip with 49 spins, using 250 problems run 100 times repetitively. items.title: ADSPICE: A Method of Automatic Differentiation for Gradient-Based Lumped Circuit Optimization with Native SPICE
items.abstract: This work presents a novel computer-aided design (CAD) tool for gradient-based circuit optimization using SPICE and automatic differentiation, which we term ADSPICE. Automatic differentiation (AD) is a technique for evaluating a derivative by breaking it into its elementary differentiation operations and repeatedly applying the chain rule, in contrast with a finite-difference-based derivative computed from a small perturbation. Native SPICE (realized with ngspice) is equipped with automatic differentiation toward gradient-based optimization, particularly adjoint-mode optimization. This is implemented with custom C code and shared library control, allowing easy integration with existing SPICE infrastructure. We show a computational performance analysis, demonstrating faster optimization vs. an existing finite-difference method, SPICE OPUS, the closest competitor in SPICE optimization tool...

items.abstract: Accurate magnetic-field evolution of spectra requires a common wavefunction representation that consistently describes multiple states across different field regimes. Discrete Variable Representation (DVR) methods combine accurate basis-based kinetic-energy evaluation with flexible real-space potential representation, enabling arbitrary non-analytic potentials to be treated. Here, we develop a magnetic-field-dependent Hermite function-based (Hermite-B) DVR that adapts naturally to magnetic confinement, efficiently representing compressed wavefunctions across a wide range of field strengths while remaining centered in regions relevant to the scalar confinement potential. items.title: Near-Quantum-Limited Readout for the Princeton Axion Search using a sub-GHz Kinetic Inductance Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
items.abstract: Parametric amplifiers are a workhorse for near-quantum-limited measurements above 1 GHz. However, amplifier development has been more limited below 1 GHz. We present a kinetic inductance traveling-wave parametric amplifier (KI-TWPA) operating over 300-700 MHz, with gain exceeding 30 dB and pump powers of a few hundred nanowatts. The system noise performance, as measured by a variable-temperature noise source, is 2.5-3.5 quanta. This device is a versatile new tool for precision measurements of sub-GHz signals, with applications including readout of semiconductor spin qubits, superconducting detector arrays, and searches for new physics beyond the Standard Model. We characterize aspects of the amplifier performance relevant to axion searches, including gain drift, compression point, amplifier noise at various operating temperatures, readout with an input circulator, and magnetic field inse...

items.title: I$_4$ complex acting as near-infrared emitter with a quantum memory in silicon
items.abstract: Silicon color centers emitting in the near infrared offer a route to spin--photon interfaces compatible with mature complementary metal--oxide--semiconductor fabrication. A key unresolved candidate is the X-line at 1039.7 meV in the photoluminescence (PL) spectrum, long attributed to a complex of four self-interstitials (I$_4$), yet whose microscopic structure and spin properties have remained controversial and uncharacterized at a predictive level. Using hybrid-functional (HSE06) density functional theory, we unambiguously establish the bare I$_4$ complex as the origin of the X-line: our calculations quantitatively reproduce the zero-phonon line, the complete phonon sideband structure---identifying the prominent secondary peaks as one- and two-phonon replicas of strongly coupled quasi-local modes---and the EPR hyperfine constants. The charge transition level is found at VBM$+$0.08~eV, c...

items.title: Revealing New Leakage Paths in GAAFETs using Predictive First-Principles Simulations
items.abstract: Gate-All-Around Field-Effect Transistors (GAAFETs) are emerging as successors to Fin Field-Effect Transistors (FinFETs) and are central to continued scaling at advanced semiconductor nodes. Despite their improved electrostatic control, recent measurements show that the drain current in GAAFETs deviates strongly from thermionic behavior at negative gate voltages, increasing as the gate voltage becomes more negative. This leakage has been attributed to direct gate-drain tunneling through the high-$k$ dielectric, enhanced by drain-induced dielectric barrier lowering (DIDBL). Here, we use predictive, charge-self-consistent Non-Equilibrium Green Function (NEGF) simulations based on the Contact Block Reduction (CBR) method to spatially resolve this leakage pathway in GAAFETs. Unlike approaches based primarily on phenomenological leakage models, our first-principles, multi-terminal quantum-tran...

items.title: BROAD: Bit-Parallel Row-Oriented Arithmetic in DRAM
items.abstract: Processing-using-memory (PUM) architectures perform computation directly within DRAM to reduce costly data movement between memory and processors. Because charge-sharing operations are confined to individual bitlines, existing DRAM-PUM architectures reorganize data into column-oriented, bit-serial representations. This organization is fundamentally incompatible with the row-oriented, word-parallel layouts used by conventional processors and accelerators, requiring expensive data-layout transformations whenever computation transitions between PUM and conventional execution. In this paper, we present BROAD, or Bit-Parallel Row-Oriented Arithmetic in DRAM. BROAD augments the DRAM subarray with two lightweight extensions: migration cells that enable localized horizontal data movement between neighboring bitlines and inversion cells that provide efficient in-array logical inversion. These pri...

items.title: SPLASH: Co-Designing Flash-Aware Sparse Attention with a Virtualized HBM-HBF Hierarchy
items.abstract: As context lengths, request lifetimes and concurrency grow, the key-value (KV) cache dominates memory usage in large language model (LLM) inference. High-bandwidth memory (HBM), the memory on contemporary GPUs, achieves far higher bandwidth than off-package memory, yet its capacity, bounded by DRAM density, has not kept pace with this demand. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF), an emerging memory technology, bridges this gap, combining the advanced packaging of HBM with the density of flash to deliver terabyte-scale capacity at HBM-class read bandwidth. Exploiting this capacity for long-context KV caches, however, requires hiding the vastly different physical characteristics of flash from the GPU while keeping decode interactive. We therefore introduce Splash, an architecture that virtualizes HBM and HBF for the KV cache. We architect custom HBM and HBF base dies with novel memory and flash cont...

items.title: Probing proximity-induced superconductivity in bilayer graphene using gate-defined quantum dots
items.abstract: Van der Waals heterostructures enable the combination of two-dimensional (2D) materials with different electronic properties in a single device. Bilayer graphene (BLG) is particularly attractive as its electrically tunable band gap enables local control of tunnel barriers and quantum dots (QDs). Here, we realize an all-2D hybrid platform based on BLG proximitized by superconducting NbSe$_2$. Using electrostatic gates, we define tunnel barriers and QDs at different distances from the superconductor-semiconductor interface. The QDs serve as local spectroscopic probes of the proximitized BLG channel, forming tunable superconductor-quantum dot-normal conductor junctions. Coulomb blockade and finite-bias spectroscopy reveal a proximity-induced superconducting gap of up to $80\,\mathrm{μeV}$ and allow to track its evolution with distance from the NbSe$_2$ contact. The local density of states r...

items.title: Continuous-Wave Operation at 30 MV/m of a Superconducting Radio-Frequency Gun Cryomodule with an Exchangeable Cathode Plug
items.abstract: A prototype 185.7 MHz superconducting radio-frequency (SRF) electron gun cryomodule has been developed for the proposed LCLS-II-HE Low Emittance Injector at SLAC. It has an in-situ ultra-high-vacuum exchangeable cathode plug system compatible with semiconductor photocathodes. With a copper plug, the gun achieved continuous-wave RF operation at a cathode field of 30 MV/m. No measurable degradation was observed after plug removal and reinsertion with the cavity at 4.4 K. This result is a significant improvement over past continuous-wave SRF gun systems with exchangeable plugs.

items.title: Heteroepitaxial Growth of PbSe on InP via III-V Buffer Layers
items.abstract: Detector cost remains a barrier to the widespread adoption of mid-wave infrared (3-5 micron) technology. PbSe, an inexpensive narrow band gap IV-VI semiconductor that has been used since the early 1940s, delivers high performance for infrared detection despite the abundance of grain boundaries in polycrystalline films. Epitaxial growth, however, could provide superior crystalline quality and interfaces, but suitable substrates remain limited for PbSe. Recent PbSe heteroepitaxy has focused primarily on III-V, II-VI and group-IV substrates that each offer a comparatively narrow range of lattice-matched alloys for heterostructure engineering. Here we show that InP-based heteroepitaxy provides access to a broader materials platform while limiting the lattice mismatch with PbSe to approximately 4%. items.title: Josephson effect in bipolar magnetic semiconductors
items.abstract: We theoretically investigate equilibrium currents in a one-dimensional Josephson junction incorporating a bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS). We show that the intrinsic exchange splitting of the spin-resolved bands enables purely electrical control of the $0$--$π$ transition through gate-tunable modulation of the BMS chemical potential, eliminating the need for an external magnetic field. This provides a viable route toward electrically tunable $π$-junction behavior and highlights the potential of BMS-based Josephson devices for phase-controllable superconducting electronics. Furthermore, in the presence of Rashba spin--orbit coupling, we find an anomalous Josephson effect characterized by a finite equilibrium supercurrent at zero phase difference. This behavior originates from the intrinsic breaking of time-reversal symmetry associated with the spin-polarized electronic structure of t...

items.title: OpenTherm: A Unified and Progressive Benchmark for 2.5D/3D-IC Thermal Prediction
items.abstract: Accurate and efficient chip thermal prediction is essential for advanced packaging design. In recent years, deep learning-based thermal predictors have made significant progress, achieving high prediction accuracy while substantially reducing computational costs. However, differences in datasets, simulators, and evaluation protocols hinder direct comparison of existing methods and systematic assessment of their generalization across design variations and cross-package transfer scenarios. We introduce OpenTherm, an open benchmark combining 32,000 established 3D-IC samples with 50,000 new 2.5D chiplet samples generated with the open-source HotSpot simulator. It provides fixed data splits, a common input representation, and shared evaluation tools. Five deployment-aligned Generalization Scopes cover fixed-design workload prediction, within-family layout, material, and cooling exploration, a...

items.title: Dual-Mode Exciton Coupling in Epitaxially Registered Organic-Inorganic 2D Heterocrystals
items.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) heterocrystals comprising molecules and semiconductors can serve as an ideal platform for studying interfacial excitons and for future optoelectronic applications, yet the energy and charge flow across these atomically sharp interfaces remain unclear. In this work, we investigated PTCDA-MoS2 as a prototypical 2D organic-inorganic heterostructure and revealed dual-mode exciton coupling between the constituent crystals. Monolayer-resolved PTCDA molecular crystals were grown on monolayer MoS2 via physical vapor assembly, and their crystallographic details, including the stacking angle, were determined by electron diffraction. Upon the formation of the heterostructures, PTCDA's photoluminescence was completely quenched because of organic-to-inorganic hole transfer, whereas that of MoS2 increased markedly with PTCDA thickness. items.title: First-principles carrier mobility and optical absorption of strained ZnO with self-consistent Hubbard interactions
items.abstract: Carrier mobility and optical absorption are key performance parameters of oxide semiconductors in transparent and flexible displays. We use a newly developed density-functional perturbation theory with a self-consistent Hubbard correction (DFPT+U) to study phonon-limited electron transport and phonon-assisted optical absorption in strained zinc oxide (ZnO). This parameter-free approach accounts for electron-phonon interactions and on-site correlation effects simultaneously. Electronic structures and phonon dispersions are computed under three distinct uniaxial strain directions. Uniaxial tensile strain up to 4.8% along [\bar110] is found to increase the room-temperature electron mobility by 19% while leaving visible-range optical absorption essentially unchanged. These results demonstrate that moderate strain can selectively enhance carrier transport without degrading optical transparenc...

items.title: Direct visualization of charge dynamics by Pockels imaging in optoelectronics
items.abstract: Understanding charge dynamics in optoelectronic devices is essential because it governs carrier transport, signal evolution, and device performance. Yet, experimental access to the spatiotemporal evolution of charge remains limited. Here, we introduce Carrier Dynamics by Pockels Imaging (CDPI), a sensitive, quantitative, and non-invasive pump-probe technique based on the linear electro-optic (Pockels) effect. CDPI images the electric-field wave associated with traveling photogenerated carriers and reveals the evolution of charge clouds in space and time. This provides direct access to fundamental transport processes, including drift, diffusion, carrier-carrier interactions, trapping, and detrapping. Furthermore, the internal conduction- and displacement-current profiles are obtained from the electric-field dynamics and shown to be consistent with the externally measured current transient...

items.title: 2D Transport in an in-plane magnetic field
items.abstract: A parallel in-plane magnetic field could, in principle, distinguish between two competing physical scenarios for the experimentally observed density-tuned 2D metal-insulator transition (where decreasing the carrier density leads to a crossover from an effective metal to an effective insulator): Wigner crystallization or Anderson localization. Since the main scattering mechanism in 2D doped semiconductors arises from screened random charged impurities and screening in turn depends on the electronic density of states, the in-plane magnetic field could distinguish between the two by decreasing screening through spin polarization and this enhances the effective critical density for Anderson localization compared with Wigner crystallization.
